sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.2856 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M, Sambalpur arising out of Sambalpur Mahila P.S. Case No.102 of 2023 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 498(A)/494/313/376/511/506/34 IPC and Section 4 of the D.P Act.
3.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the case diary in the meanwhile.
5. As an interim measure, it is directed that Petitioner Nos.2 to 10, who are in-laws, shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case till the next date.
6. It is needless to state that the Petitioner Nos.2 to 10 shall cooperate with the investigating agency.
